    closest_girl = None

            dx = abs(girl_center[0] - bandana_center[0])
            dy = abs(girl_center[1] - bandana_center[1])
            distance = math.sqrt(dx**2 + dy**2)
            if distance < closest_distance:
                closest_distance = distance
                closest_girl = girl_patches[girl_centers.index(girl_center)]
    
    return closest_girl
